changes: Added core functionality.

patches.description: Moved to a typescript code base and implemented an overlay.
changes: Refactored codebase to TypeScript.
Implemented overlay for better user experience.
Introduced Settings section to manage the overlay based on user preference
made the rotation details collapsable so it can be hidden when not being edited
Fixed minor bugs from previous version.
Optimisied the UI to reduce the lag.
Fixed bugs related to overlay rendering.
Updated the main header to be more unique to this app
Fixed a bug with saving rotation names being null
Introduced patch notes feature to keep users informed about updates.
Automatically view patch notes if the system detects a new version
Corrected a typo in the 2.1.0 changes.
Added a show patch notes button so that all patch notes can be viewed
Ordered patch notes in descending order so that newer versions come first
The add action button wasn't working, sorry! it's fixed now.

patches.description: Allow multiple rotations per set for easy cycling between phases
changes: Rotations are now saved in sets, the sets will contain one or many rotations! This means you can have a rotation for each phase of a boss, or just for convenience.
Added the ability to have multiple rotations per set.
Overlay now shows the selected rotation, and can cycle to the next rotation by pressing the main alt1 keybind (default is alt + 1).
Updated the UI to accommodate multiple rotations.
Moved the close button on this patch notes window to the top right corner so that it is more consistent with other windows.

patches.description: Patch - Fixed a bug with switching to old rotations
changes: Added functionality to enable users to switch to an older rotation set, which was saved in the old data format.
This isn't really much of a function change, but I have created a discord server for people to hop on and share rotations and feedback!
Added a button on the bottom of the settings section with a link to the discord server
Fixed a bug that was causing the overlays to flicker when using the Better Buff Bars addon at the same time.

patches.description: Better Rotation Notation! This is a major version increment so there may be bugs (hopefully not too many), if you do find any please feel free to come bother me on the discord about them.
changes: Introduce separator selector and notes input for each dropdown. This allows for more complex rotations to be created, such as those where you need to press 2 abilities at the same time!
Notes, added the ability to add a note to each ability which is shown in the overlay over the image
Separator and notes are saved/loaded with rotations and shown in the preview, Default separator is '→', notes default to null

patches.description: Bug Fixes and Quality of Life Improvements
changes: Added 'tc' to the list of separators to allow for better notation of rotations that require a target cycle.
Added '↵'(new line) options to allow you to mark that you want a certain ability to be at the start of a line.
Resolved a bug with deleting rotations.
Added an edit rotation button. which opens a new popup. In this popup you can paste a rotation from PVME.
filter by Emoji names eg 'gconc'

patches.description: Angular Migration - This is a major version increment as it is a complete rewrite of the codebase. But it comes with some great QOL improvements and new features!
changes: Migrated the codebase to Angular.
Updated dependencies and fixed any breaking changes.
Refactored components to follow Angular best practices for easier maintenance and scalability.
Added drag and drop functionality for rotation sets, allowing users to easily reorder their rotations.
Implemented lazy loading for rotation sets to improve initial load time.
Added a label overlay feature that displays the rotation name on the overlay when first switching to the rotation.
Updated UI buttons to make more use of symbols and icons for a cleaner look.
Updated the message when the app is opened in a non-alt1 browser.
Added an alt1 version check to prompt user to update alt1 if needed.
Fixed a bug where the bottom of the rotation is getting cut off when there is lots of abilities in the rotation.
Changed the default behaviour of the Copy Ability button to put the copied ability at the end of the rotation.
Added a context menu to the copy button with options to 'Copy Here' or 'Copy to End'.

Added a new setting in the rotation section where you can specify a phase/wave for each rotation. The app will then automatically switch to the correct rotation when it detects a phase/wave change in the game.
This feature is experimental and may not work perfectly in all situations. Please report any issues on the discord server.

patches.description: Well Jagex went and broke everything by changing all the abilities! You will likely find that some of your old rotations now have big blank spots in them because the ability that used to be there no longer exists!
changes: Updated available abilities to be in line with the new combat changes.

patches.description: Performance overhaul for large rotations, plus new PVME ability and gear icons.
changes: Large rotations should now feel much snappier when adding, editing, copying, or reordering abilities.
Ability dropdowns only load the list when opened, use virtual scrolling, and only one dropdown stays open at a time.
Preview and overlay no longer rebuild the whole UI on every small edit. Overlay recapture is cached until the selected rotation actually changes.
Running the app in a normal browser (localhost) no longer starts the Alt1 overlay loop, so you can test rotations without that extra lag.

Synced new icons from PVME: combat variants (Penance/Vampyrism aspects, caroming, lunging, igneous Deadshot), Masterwork ranged, Superior seasinger/Death Lotus/Tetsu, blood necklaces, Necromancy Basic, Death Spark (charging), and more.
Added a Blank space option at the top of the ability list. It occupies the same size as a normal ability so you can skip a line or leave a gap in the overlay. Search for blank, space, or spacer.
Fixed Ctrl+C in text fields duplicating the ability instead of only copying the selected text.
Re-downloaded post-combat ability icons from PVME so new abilities (Deadshot, Sunshine, gconc, Chain, etc.) no longer share the old pre-rework artwork.
